problem_statement: Build a basic Task Management CRUD app

in_scope: Task filtering (by status, priority, due date)
Task sorting (by status, priority, due date)
out_scope: Integration with other project management tools

architect_agent.database_schema:
```sql
CREATE TABLE users (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    username TEXT NOT NULL,
    password TEXT NOT NULL,
    role TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE tasks (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    description TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    priority TEXT NOT NULL,
    due_date DATE NOT NULL,
    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
);

CREATE TABLE task_history (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    task_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (task_id) REFERENCES tasks (id)
);
```

